Read-only delta re-check since 733ea76c (not built). The delta is clean, so the label stays `needs-maintainer`: the new `resvg` dev-dependency in xtask is still the maintainer's call.

What the delta holds:
- Commits since 733ea76c: a merge of main (2449f2cb, which brings in #1117 and #1114) and b908a6a0, the only commit of the PR's own.
- b908a6a0 changes exactly seven files: `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` (17 -> 18), `assets/ui/svg/op-face.svg`, `op-groove-rough.svg`, `op-groove-finish.svg`, and their three PNGs. It has no Rust change and nothing under `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/`.
- The three SVG masters are plain `rect`, `path` and `circle` shapes on the 0 0 24 24 grid. They contain no text, script, image, external reference or product name; `<title>` holds only the icon name.
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` at the head is 18. Main (71d67845) is at 17, so 18 is the next free number.
- Nothing under `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/` differs between 733ea76c and the head.

Not checked by me: the PNG pixels (I did not render them), and the xtask results. The author reports `cargo test -p xtask` at 38 passed and `cargo xtask icons --check` at 0 problems on this head; I did not rebuild.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
